title: Welcome to the table
subject: Welcome to Farm to Table, {{first_name}}
pre: Good food. Local roots. Your next favourite farm awaits.
heading: A little closer to the source.
body: Welcome to Farm to Table, {{first_name}}. We’re happy you’re here. Discover seasonal produce, meet the people who grow it, and bring something good to your table.
note: Start with what’s in season, explore a local farm, or find a new everyday favourite. Your next fresh discovery is waiting.

title: Verify email
subject: Verify your Farm to Table email
pre: One small step before you get started.
heading: Let’s make it official.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for joining Farm to Table. Please confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
note: This link expires in {{expiry_duration}} and can only be used once. If you didn’t create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

title: Reset password
subject: Reset your Farm to Table password
pre: A secure link to get you back to your account.
heading: A fresh start for your password.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, we received a request to reset the password for your Farm to Table account. Use the secure link below to choose a new one.
note: This link expires in {{expiry_duration}} and can only be used once. Didn’t request this? Ignore this email; your password will stay the same. Never share this link with anyone.

title: Password changed
subject: Your Farm to Table password was changed
pre: A security update for your account.
heading: Your password is updated.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, the password for your Farm to Table account was changed on {{changed_at}}. If this was you, no further action is needed.
note: If you didn’t make this change, contact our support team immediately so we can help secure your account.

title: New promotion
subject: {{offer_title}} — fresh picks from Farm to Table
pre: A little something for your next farm-fresh basket.
heading: Fresh finds. A little extra joy.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, there’s something good waiting at the market. Enjoy {{offer_description}} on {{eligible_products}} and make your next meal a little more special.
note: Use code {{promo_code}} at checkout. Offer ends {{offer_end_date}} ({{offer_timezone}}). {{offer_terms}}

title: Seasonal farm notes
subject: Fresh this season: {{seasonal_highlight}}
pre: What’s growing, who’s harvesting, and what to cook next.
heading: A taste of the season.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, this month we’re celebrating {{seasonal_highlight}}. Explore what’s arriving from our farms and discover fresh inspiration for your table.
note: From the farm: {{farm_story}}. In the kitchen: {{recipe_teaser}}.

title: Basket reminder
subject: Something fresh is waiting in your basket
pre: Pick up where you left off, whenever you’re ready.
heading: Saved for another moment.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, you left a few good things in your basket. If you’re still planning your next meal, you can return to your picks below.
note: {{cart_summary}}. Availability and prices may change; items are not reserved until your order is confirmed.

title: Order confirmation
subject: Order {{order_number}} confirmed — thank you!
pre: Your order details, all in one place.
heading: Good things are on their way.
body: Thanks, {{first_name}}. We’ve confirmed order {{order_number}}. Here’s a summary of what you ordered.
note:
Items: {{order_items_summary}}
Items subtotal: {{subtotal}}
Delivery: {{delivery_fee}}
Discount: {{discount}}
Total (including applicable tax): {{order_total}}
Delivery address: {{delivery_address}}
Estimated delivery: {{delivery_window}}
Seller: {{seller_name}}

title: Delivery update
subject: An update on order {{order_number}}
pre: The latest on your farm-fresh delivery.
heading: From the farm to your door.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, here’s the latest on order {{order_number}}: {{delivery_status}}.
note:
Estimated arrival: {{delivery_window}}
Delivery details: {{delivery_instructions}}
Store chilled and frozen items promptly after delivery, following the product label.

title: Refund update
subject: Refund update for order {{order_number}}
pre: Here are the details of your refund.
heading: Your refund, explained.
body: Hi {{first_name}}, the refund status for order {{order_number}} is: {{refund_status}}.
note:
Refund amount: {{refund_amount}}
Refund method: {{refund_method}}
Reason: {{refund_reason}}
Expected processing time: {{refund_timeline}}. Your payment provider may take additional time to show the funds.
